info.name: Nelna ERP Support API QA Collection
info.description: Company-ready API regression suite for Nelna ERP Support & Improvement System. The app authenticates with the HTTP-only nelna_erp_session cookie. This collection captures the cookie value as authToken variables for Newman execution.

exec: pm.test('Response time is under 5000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000); });
const bodyText = pm.response.text();

['passwordHash', 'JWT_SECRET', 'MONGODB_URI', 'DATABASE_URL', 'MAIN_DATABASE_URL', 'BACKUP_DATABASE_URL', 'SMTP_PASS'].forEach(function (key) { pm.test('No sensitive field leaked: ' + key, function () { pm.expect(bodyText).to.not.include(key); }); });
pm.test('Health endpoint is reachable or target deployment is pending', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 502, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) {
const json = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Health response has required fields', function () { pm.expect(json).to.have.keys(['status', 'app', 'timestamp', 'database', 'environment']); });
pm.test('Health status is ok', function () { pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('ok'); });
} else {
pm.test('Health endpoint strict check skipped until target deploy includes /api/health', function () { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Unauthenticated me is handled safely', function () { pm.expect([200, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Unauthenticated me returns null user', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.eql(null); }); }
pm.test('Invalid login is rejected', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Invalid login does not return a session cookie', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').to.not.include('nelna_erp_session='); });
pm.test('Missing login fields are rejected', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('NoSQL-style login payload is rejected', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
const hasCreds = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminEmail') && pm.environment.get('adminPassword'));
if (!hasCreds) {
pm.test('Skipped until admin credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
} else {
pm.test('Admin login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
const setCookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '';
const match = setCookie.match(/nelna_erp_session=([^;]+)/);
pm.test('Admin session cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(Boolean(match)).to.eql(true); });
if (match) { pm.environment.set('authToken', match[1]); pm.environment.set('adminToken', match[1]); }
const hasCreds = Boolean(pm.environment.get('staffEmail') && pm.environment.get('staffPassword'));
if (!hasCreds) { pm.test('Skipped until staff credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('Staff login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); const match = (pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').match(/nelna_erp_session=([^;]+)/); pm.test('Staff session cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(Boolean(match)).to.eql(true); }); if (match) { pm.environment.set('staffToken', match[1]); } }
const hasCreds = Boolean(pm.environment.get('itEmail') && pm.environment.get('itPassword'));
if (!hasCreds) { pm.test('Skipped until IT credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('IT login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); const match = (pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').match(/nelna_erp_session=([^;]+)/); pm.test('IT session cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(Boolean(match)).to.eql(true); }); if (match) { pm.environment.set('itToken', match[1]); } }
const hasCreds = Boolean(pm.environment.get('managerEmail') && pm.environment.get('managerPassword'));
if (!hasCreds) { pm.test('Skipped until manager credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('Manager login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); const match = (pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').match(/nelna_erp_session=([^;]+)/); pm.test('Manager session cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(Boolean(match)).to.eql(true); }); if (match) { pm.environment.set('managerToken', match[1]); } }
const hasCreds = Boolean(pm.environment.get('vendorEmail') && pm.environment.get('vendorPassword'));
if (!hasCreds) { pm.test('Skipped until vendor credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect([400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('Vendor login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); const match = (pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '').match(/nelna_erp_session=([^;]+)/); pm.test('Vendor session cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(Boolean(match)).to.eql(true); }); if (match) { pm.environment.set('vendorToken', match[1]); } }
const hasToken = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminToken'));
if (!hasToken) { pm.test('Skipped until admin token is available', function () { pm.expect([200, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('Admin me succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); pm.test('Admin user object returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.be.an('object'); }); }
const hasToken = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminToken'));
if (!hasToken) { pm.test('Skipped until admin token is available', function () { pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }
else {
pm.test('Reference data loads for admin', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
const json = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Reference has departments/modules/constants', function () { pm.expect(json.departments).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.erpModules).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.constants).to.be.an('object'); });
if (json.departments && json.departments[0]) pm.environment.set('departmentId', json.departments[0]._id);
if (json.erpModules && json.erpModules[0]) pm.environment.set('erpModuleId', json.erpModules[0]._id);
if (json.vendors && json.vendors[0]) pm.environment.set('vendorId', json.vendors[0]._id);
const hasToken = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminToken'));
if (!hasToken) { pm.test('Skipped until admin token is available', function () { pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }

else { pm.test('Admin dashboard loads', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); pm.test('Dashboard has cards and charts', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.cards).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.charts).to.be.an('object'); }); }
const hasToken = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminToken'));
if (!hasToken) { pm.test('Skipped until admin token is available', function () { pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }
else { pm.test('Admin audit logs load', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); }
const hasToken = Boolean(pm.environment.get('adminToken'));
if (!hasToken) { pm.test('Skipped until admin token is available', function () { pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }
else { pm.test('Admin email logs load', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); }); }
